headline: ARY needs almost no new suppliers for the new categories — every principal that owns them (P&G/Pampers, Unicharm/MamyPoko, Nestle/Lactogen-Cerelac, ITC/Master Chef, McCain, Vadilal) already has a named distributor invoicing Baru Sahib on a live route; the only genuine gaps are a drug licence + Rx wholesaler and an optical/hardware rack, and Delhi HO cannot help because in 3.5 years it has booked exactly one purchase voucher, for zero rupees.

findings.claim: There is no Delhi HO purchasing function to leverage. LocationID 1 (Ary Ho, 07AACCJ4223F1ZY, New Delhi 110027) has ONE purchase voucher in the entire book — dated 2023-04-01, value ₹0. Baru Sahib (LocationID 15) has booked 7,711 bills / ₹19.03 Cr all-time and 100% of the last 12 months. Bathinda (16) bought ₹41.2 L but stopped 2024-07-08.
findings.evidence: ary query "SELECT h.LocationID, COUNT(*) bills, CAST(SUM(h.BillAmount) AS bigint) val, MIN(h.VoucherDate) frm, MAX(h.VoucherDate) tto FROM PurchaseHeader h WHERE h.IsDeleted=0 GROUP BY h.LocationID" → 15: 7711 bills ₹190,348,455 (2023-04-01→2026-08-21); 16: 1509 bills ₹4,122,595 (→2024-07-08); 1: 1 bill ₹0 (2023-04-01 only). Plus 12m: only LocationID 15, 2,966 bills ₹6.36 Cr, 149 suppliers.
findings.number: 1 voucher, ₹0, all-time at Delhi HO vs 2,966 bills / ₹6.36 Cr in 12m at Baru Sahib
findings.soWhat: Every plan that says 'Delhi HO will negotiate/buy this' is fiction. The buying desk is at Baru Sahib and it is the only one with vendor relationships, so new-category onboarding must be given to the Baru Sahib purchase desk. Delhi HO's only proven use is as an intercompany SUPPLIER (₹9.42 L / 19 bills, 2023-04 to 2024-09, now dormant).

findings.claim: Every FMCG principal that owns a new category already has a named, live distributor delivering to Baru Sahib. P&G (→ Pampers) comes via Nirman Associates Pvt Ltd, Parwanoo, GSTIN 02AAHCN2037L1ZM. Unicharm (→ MamyPoko) via Himachal Wholesale Syndicate, Parwanoo 173220, 02AABFH6020J1ZX. Nestle (→ Lactogen/NAN/Cerelac) via Parhlad Chand Batra & Sons, 02ABMPB2280L1ZV. ITC (→ Master Chef frozen) via Solan Agencies, 02AERPS9622K1ZX.
findings.evidence: Brand-keyword classification over 12m purchase lines: ary query mapping ProductName LIKE patterns to principals, joined to AccountMaster — P&G/Nirman ₹414,611 (195 lines); Unicharm/Himachal Wholesale Syndicate ₹212,210 (33); Nestle/Parhlad Chand Batra ₹1,223,837 (250); ITC/Solan Agencies ₹1,510,605 (485). Window 2025-08-01→2026-08-21.
findings.number: 17 principals mapped to 15 named distributors, ₹1.19 Cr of 12m purchases
findings.soWhat: Category entry is a phone call to an existing vendor with an existing credit line and an existing vehicle, not a vendor hunt. Onboarding cost for diapers, infant formula and branded frozen is effectively zero — which collapses the timeline from months to weeks.

findings.claim: The deep-freeze cold chain into Baru Sahib already exists and runs. Vadilal ice cream arrives via Shiv Shakti, Baddi (02DMSPK8891Q1ZV) — ₹350,856 over 173 purchase lines in 12m; McCain frozen arrives via Laxmi Narayan Suresh Kumar, Solan (02AAZPA4737B1Z0) — 23 bills in 12m, one every 16 days, ₹14,660 average bill.
findings.evidence: ary query on PurchaseDetail joined to ProductMaster where ProductName LIKE '%Vadilal%' / '%Mccain%'/'%Mccam%', grouped by AccountMaster, 2025-08-01 onward; plus cadence query COUNT(*) bills per supplier 12m (Shiv Shakti 14 bills avg ₹31,440; Laxmi Narayan Suresh Kumar 23 bills avg ₹14,660).
findings.number: Vadilal ₹3.51 L / 173 lines; McCain 23 deliveries in 12m
findings.soWhat: Frozen is an ASSORTMENT decision, not a cold-chain capex project. The brief's 'Frozen Rs 0.52 L / 57 SKUs' is a range problem — ARY is running a freezer route 23 times a year to sell ₹52k. Filling that same vehicle with Godrej Yummiez, ITC Master Chef and Safal is the cheapest revenue in this whole lane.

findings.claim: Fresh fruit & vegetables — ₹62.7 L of 12m sales — are single-sourced from ONE vendor 100+ km away in Haryana with no GSTIN on file: M/S Shashi Bhushan Manoj Kumar Aeron, Naraingarh (Ambala dist.), pincode 134203. 261 bills in 12 months (one every 1.4 days), ₹71.0 L, ₹27,192 average bill, and it also supplies the pizza cheese and Hf Super Milk.
findings.evidence: ary purchases by-supplier -n 40; per-supplier product mix (Apple ₹11.67 L, Onion ₹11.10 L, Banana ₹8.27 L, Tomato ₹7.87 L, Potato ₹7.44 L, Pomegranate ₹6.34 L, Pizza Cheese ₹7.47 L); groups 129 Fruits + 159 Vegetable 24m = 298 + 452 bills, ₹1.11 Cr, this vendor >98% of both; AccountMaster/CityMaster → CityName 'Naraingarh', StateName 'Haryana', GSTINNo blank.
findings.number: ₹71 L / 261 deliveries / 1 vendor / 0 GSTIN
findings.soWhat: This is the single biggest continuity risk in ARY's supply chain — one unregistered proprietor, one hill road, 6,197 selling SKUs depending partly on him. A second source (Solan/Nahan APMC, HPMC Parwanoo, local Rajgarh growers) is risk work, not growth work, and should be priced as insurance.

findings.claim: There is an on-site cold store at Baru Sahib being purchased from: supplier account 'Cold Store Baru Sahib Customer' issued 93 bills in 12m (₹1,688 average) into groups 129/159 (Fruits/Vegetable), and 'Akal Bakery - Baru Sahib' (115 bills), 'Akal Dairy - Baru Sahib' (73), 'Akal Catering Mess' (56), 'Akal Modi Khana - Baru Sahib' and 'Local Purchase' (105) are all active supplier accounts.
findings.evidence: ary delivery-cadence query on PurchaseHeader 12m grouped by AccountName; and group 129/159 supplier query 24m showing 'Cold Store Baru Sahib Customer' 30 + 135 bills.
findings.number: 93 cold-store bills, 115 bakery, 73 dairy, 56 mess in 12m
findings.soWhat: The campus already operates its own cold store, bakery, dairy and mess and ARY buys from them. Any fresh/frozen/dairy expansion should be routed through that existing cold store rather than new equipment, and the campus dairy caps how much packaged milk expansion is realistic.

findings.claim: ₹1.28 Cr — 20% of 12-month purchases, 1,825 of 2,966 bills — comes from 16 suppliers with NO GSTIN recorded in AccountMaster, including the #1 (Aeron, ₹71 L), Hygienic Milk (Mohali, ₹25.7 L) and Sehgal Trading Co. (Rajgarh, ₹7.9 L).
findings.evidence: ary query grouping PurchaseHeader 12m by CASE WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(a.GSTINNo))='' → NO GSTIN: 16 suppliers, 1,825 bills, ₹12,755,511; HAS GSTIN: 133 suppliers, 1,141 bills, ₹50,823,898.
findings.number: ₹1.28 Cr / 20% of purchases from 16 GSTIN-less vendors
findings.soWhat: Either these are composition/unregistered dealers (no input tax credit, correct as recorded) or the GSTIN is simply missing from the master and ITC is being lost on ₹1.28 Cr. At an 18% blended rate the second case is worth up to ~₹23 L/yr. It has to be resolved before adding vendors, or the new categories inherit the same hole.

findings.claim: Prescription medicine is genuinely absent — not thin. A LIKE scan for tablet / syrup / capsule / paracetamol / crocin / dolo across all 21,466 SKUs returns zero medicines (only rose syrup and Hershey's syrup). The 'Medicare' group 138 with 272 active SKUs is pure OTC: Dettol antiseptic ₹20,214, GSK Eno ₹17,931, Dabur Honitus ₹17,202, Vicks Vaporub ₹10,833, Boroline ₹9,945, Dabur Glucose-D, Johnson's Benadryl.
findings.evidence: ary query on ProductMaster ProductName LIKE '%tablet%'/'%syrup%'/'%capsule%'/'%paracetamol%'/'%crocin%'/'%dolo%' → no drug SKUs; group 138 top sellers 12m via SaleHeader/SaleDetail join.
findings.number: 0 Schedule-H SKUs in 21,466; Medicare = ₹3.15 L/yr of OTC
findings.soWhat: A 5,000-person township 30–50 km from a market has no pharmacy in its only shop. This is the largest single category gap in the business and the only one that needs a licence rather than a phone call.

findings.claim: Baby care is NOT absent — the brief's '3 Baby Accessories SKUs' undercounts it badly. 69 SKUs containing baby/diaper/Pampers/Johnson's sold ₹1.89 L in 12 months: Pampers pants in 3 sizes (223 packs, ₹21,790), the full Johnson's baby range (~₹40k) and Himalaya baby range (~₹41k). The comparable adjacent category — Sofy/Stayfree/Whisper sanitary — did ₹4.54 L on 18 SKUs, 2.4× the entire baby range.
findings.evidence: ary query SaleHeader/SaleDetail/ProductMaster 12m, ProductName LIKE baby/diaper/pamper/mamy/cerelac/lactogen/johnson → 69 SKUs, 1,627 units, ₹189,456; sanitary query → ₹454,017 across 18 SKUs. Purchase side: all Pampers via Nirman Associates Pvt Ltd, Parwanoo (last bill 2026-08-11); MamyPoko bought once via Himachal Wholesale Syndicate, Dec-2023, then dropped.
findings.number: Baby ₹1.89 L vs sanitary ₹4.54 L on 18 SKUs
findings.soWhat: The category is mis-taxonomised, not missing. Fixing the group tree and adding a MamyPoko line back (the Unicharm vendor is already live, already ARY's Sofy supplier) is a same-week action with no new vendor and no new licence.

findings.claim: Dairy already runs on three named routes with proven cadence: Amul via Leela Associates, Hospital Road Solan 173212 (02BHSPB6268F2ZC) — 126 bills in 12m, one every 2.9 days, ₹12,931 average; Verka via Sahni Trading Co., Parwanoo 173220 (02ABZPS8831R1ZG) — ₹174,095; loose milk and desi ghee via Hygienic Milk, Mohali — 880 bills in 12m, 2.4 per day; local paneer via Sehgal Trading Co., Rajgarh 173101 — 215 bills.
findings.evidence: ary query on Verka/Amul/Hf brand SKUs grouped by supplier; delivery-cadence query 12m (Hygienic Milk 880 bills avg ₹2,922; Leela Associates 126 bills; Sehgal Trading 215 bills); group 193 Dairy supplier query 24m.
findings.number: Amul every 2.9 days; loose milk 2.4×/day
findings.soWhat: A cold, 2–3-day-cycle dairy route into 173101 already exists. Dahi/paneer/butter/UHT range extension needs no new logistics — but the campus's own Akal Dairy caps how much packaged milk ARY can realistically take.

findings.claim: HP Milkfed (Himachal Pradesh State Co-operative Milk Producers' Federation) formally covers Sirmaur district — it took over dairy development in Mandi, Bilaspur, Hamirpur, Sirmaur, Solan and part of Shimla — and is an untapped route. No plant or chilling centre in Nahan or Paonta Sahib could be confirmed.
findings.evidence: hpmilkfed.org/about and hpmilkfed.org/sirmaur exist and state the district coverage (via search result text), but every direct fetch failed: https://hpmilkfed.org/plant-locations/ → 'certificate has expired'; r.jina.ai proxy → HTTP 422; hpmilkfed.org.in → DNS not found.
findings.number: 6 districts incl. Sirmaur
findings.soWhat: A state co-operative dairy that already has a Sirmaur mandate is the cheapest possible second dairy source and a political win with a Himachal institution. It needs one phone call to HP Milkfed Shimla, which nobody at ARY appears to have made.

findings.claim: HPMC (HP Horticultural Produce Marketing & Processing Corp) has a fruit processing plant with 18,000 MT apple capacity AND cold-storage terminal capacity at PARWANOO — the exact town where four of ARY's biggest FMCG vendors sit (173220). Total HPMC cold storage ~11,500 MT across Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai and Parwanoo. Corporate office Shimla, +91-177-2623835.
findings.evidence: https://www.hpmc.in/ — Parwanoo plant 18,000 MT apple processing; CA stores at Gumma, Jarol, Oddi, Rohru, Patlikhul (640 MT); cold storage terminals Delhi/Mumbai/Chennai/Parwanoo ~11,500 MT; product range apple juice concentrate, tetrapak juices, cider vinegar, jams, pickles, wines, squash, mineral water.
findings.number: 18,000 MT plant at Parwanoo; ₹0 new logistics
findings.soWhat: ARY's Parwanoo vendors already run a vehicle to Baru Sahib. HPMC Parwanoo is a same-town backhaul for (a) a second F&V source and (b) a Himachal-branded juice/jam/pickle line that fits a Himachal institution's story. This is the highest-leverage unexploited route found.

findings.claim: A retail pharmacy needs Form 19 application → Form 20 (drugs other than Schedule C/C1) and Form 21 (Schedule C/C1), a minimum 10 sq m premises, and a registered pharmacist (B.Pharm/D.Pharm on the State Pharmacy Council register). If ARY also wants to wholesale to the campus hospital it needs Form 20-B/21-B and the premises rises to 15 sq m with a 'competent person' (graduate + 1 yr drug-trade experience, or non-graduate + 4 yrs). Application fees fall in the ₹500–₹1,500 band; the licence is valid 5 years and is issued by the state drug control authority.
findings.evidence: https://cleartax.in/s/drug-license (forms 19/19A/19B/19C, retail 10 sq m, retail+wholesale 15 sq m, fees 'Rs.1,500 to 500', 5-year validity, State Drugs Standard Control Organisation) corroborated by https://www.indiafilings.com/learn/drug-license/ ('minimum area of 10 square meters' for Form 20/21 or 20-B/21-B; 'For retail sale registered pharmacist'; 'For wholesale licence competent person'; issued by the state Food Safety and Drug Administration).
findings.number: 10 sq m + 1 registered pharmacist + ₹500–1,500 fee + 5-yr validity
findings.soWhat: The barrier is a person, not money. ₹1,500 of fees and 10 sq m of an existing counter are trivial; finding and naming a pharmacist on the HP register who will sit at Baru Sahib is the whole project. The campus hospital is the obvious place to find one.

findings.claim: Named Rx wholesale candidates exist inside the 60 km catchment — Nahan (173001): Malhotra Medical Hall, Gautam Medical Store, Shivam Pharma; Paonta Sahib (173025): Utkarsh Medicose, Vidit Healthcare, Q Care; Solan (173212): Sharma Medicose, Utthan Medicos, Arogya Pharmacy, TSD Enterprises, M S Hadimba Medical Store, Chimak Health Care; Baddi/Nalagarh: Sahil Pharma, Sony Traders, Daneesha Enterprises. Note that Himachal's Baddi–Barotiwala–Nalagarh and Kala Amb belts are MANUFACTURING hubs (Softex Surgical Cotton and Symbiosis Pharmaceuticals at Kala Amb; SBS Biotech at Village Jattan, Nahan Road, Kala Amb) — manufacturers, not the stockists a shop buys from.
findings.evidence: https://dir.indiamart.com/sirmaur/pharmaceutical-drug.html; https://dir.indiamart.com/solan/pharmaceutical-drug.html; https://dir.indiamart.com/paonta-sahib/pharmaceutical-drug.html; https://dir.indiamart.com/baddi/pharmaceutical-drug.html; Kala Amb/Nahan manufacturer addresses from ayurveda.hp.gov.in licensed-pharmacy listings surfaced in search.
findings.number: 14 named candidates across Nahan / Paonta Sahib / Solan / Baddi
findings.soWhat: Directory-grade names, phones unverified — treat as a call list, not a shortlist. The strategic point is that Baru Sahib's pharma supply will come from a Nahan or Solan chemist-wholesaler, NOT from the Baddi pharma hub, and the Baddi 'India's pharma capital' framing is a red herring for a retail shop.

findings.claim: Hardware, electricals, kitchen and crockery already ride two established out-of-state vendors, so a hardware/tools line needs no new supplier: Harminder Singh & Bros, New Delhi (07AASPS8364B1Z8) — Appliances ₹126,279 + Kitchen Utility ₹119,003 + Household ₹57,534 + Cookware ₹37,210 over 24m, 16 bills in 12m; R.K. Sales Corporation, Chandigarh (04ACPPD8329N1Z6) — Household ₹370,475 + Kitchen ₹80,535 + Cookware ₹57,908; R.K Glass & Crockery, Chandigarh, Shiv Mandir Road Sec-52 (04ABGPK9611A1Z6) — ₹362,299 + ₹103,900; locally Bansal Brothers, Solan (02BAGPB6317J2Z3) and Cm Trading Co., Solan (02AFYPA7109M1Z8) already supply Electricals.
findings.evidence: ary query on groups 123 Electricals / 109 Appliances / 116 Cookware / 136 Kitchen Utility / 134 House Hold, 24m, grouped by AccountMaster + CityMaster.
findings.number: 5 existing vendors, ₹13.2 L of 24m hardware-adjacent purchases
findings.soWhat: 'No group exists for hardware/tools' is a taxonomy gap, not a sourcing gap. Ask the same five vendors for a Taparia/Stanley hand-tool and a Havells/Anchor electrical rack and it lands on the next vehicle.

findings.claim: For new-vendor electrical and optical lines, Chandigarh is the real wholesale market with priced, named suppliers. Electricals: New Jaspal Electricals (L&T switches ₹35/pc), Jai Durga Electric Co. (Havells modular), Aggarwal Electric Store, Durga Yantra India (+91 8047526885, ₹149/pc), Bharat Electrical Industries (+91 7942624377, ₹140/pc), R.M. Engineering — brands Havells, Anchor, Legrand, Schneider, L&T, Great White, ₹8–₹2,550/pc. Optical frames: Spectsmakers (TR-90 half rim ₹110/pc), A-One Opticals (₹140/pc), Trident Enterprises (polycarbonate TR-90 ₹350/pc); Chandigarh frame band ₹85–₹900/pc with most mainstream frames ₹100–₹200.
findings.evidence: https://dir.indiamart.com/chandigarh/electrical-switches.html and https://dir.indiamart.com/chandigarh/spectacle-frames.html (fetched 2026-08-28).
findings.number: Frames ₹85–900/pc, mainstream ₹100–200; switches ₹8–2,550/pc
findings.soWhat: A reading-glasses and sunglasses rack for 5,000 residents including elderly staff costs ₹110–350 a frame at wholesale against ₹400–800 retail — the highest-margin, lowest-risk new SKU family in this lane, and it fits on a shelf. ARY already buys from Chandigarh (04) vendors 6 times a year, so the route is proven.

findings.claim: Pet care has no real Himachal distribution and probably no real demand. The only HP-area listings are Thapa Golds (Solan, carries Pedigree), Gopalji Medicare Solutions (Samolac pet food, +91 7942824936), Tak Herbals (+91 8043823360), G K Manufacturers India (+91 8047643574) and Danodia Foods (bird seed) — none are brand distributors. Brands available in the region are Pedigree, Drools, Royal Canin, Whiskas, Farmina at ₹170–₹2,400/kg.
findings.evidence: https://dir.indiamart.com/solan/pet-food.html (fetched 2026-08-28). Demand judgement is inference from the campus profile, not measured — ARY's catalogue has no pet SKU to measure.
findings.number: ₹170–2,400/kg; 0 distributor-grade vendors in HP
findings.soWhat: Deprioritise. A residential Sikh institution of students and staff quarters is not a pet market, there is no supply route, and the effort is better spent on the pharmacy. Say no to this one rather than half-building it.

findings.claim: Mobile accessories have no verifiable HP or Chandigarh wholesale route in the directories, so this stays a Delhi run — which fits ARY's existing pattern (it already buys appliances and electricals from Harminder Singh & Bros, New Delhi, and garments from Chandni Chowk 110006 via 27 vendors, ₹25.8 L in 12m). Named Delhi accessory markets are Gaffar Market/Karol Bagh, Bhagirath Palace and Nehru Place, but no named firm could be retrieved.
findings.evidence: Three fetch attempts failed: https://dir.indiamart.com/chandigarh/mobile-accessories.html → 404; https://dir.indiamart.com/delhi/mobile-accessories.html → 404; https://dir.indiamart.com/impcat/mobile-phone-accessories.html?city=Chandigarh returned only Delhi/Mumbai/Surat national sellers with no Chandigarh firm. Current state VERIFIED: 8 active mobile SKUs, ₹2,690 of 12m sales (brief).
findings.number: 8 SKUs, ₹2,690/yr today
findings.soWhat: Do not commit to a mobile-accessory line until someone walks Gaffar Market or Bhagirath Palace, and check first whether the residential school permits selling chargers and earphones to students — that rule, not supply, decides the size of this category.

findings.claim: Lead times and minimum orders are already measurable from bill cadence and minimum bill values — no vendor negotiation needed to know them. Daily/near-daily: Hygienic Milk (Mohali) 880 bills, Aeron (Naraingarh) every 1.4 days, Sehgal Trading (Rajgarh) every 1.7 days. Twice-weekly: Leela Associates (Solan) every 2.9 days. Fortnightly: Sahni Trading 13.0 days, Mangla Sales 13.5, Solan Agencies 14.6, Parhlad Chand Batra 16.6. Monthly: Shiv Shakti (Baddi) 26.1, Dharam Pal & Sons (Chandigarh) 28.1. Effective MOQ from minimum bill: Himachal Wholesale Syndicate ₹570 (no MOQ), Mangla Sales ₹5,000, Solan Agencies ₹7,949, Dharam Pal & Sons ₹111,271 (truckload).
findings.evidence: ary query on PurchaseHeader 12m: COUNT(*) bills, 365.0/COUNT(*) as avg_days_between, AVG/MIN/MAX(BillAmount) grouped by supplier, HAVING COUNT(*)>=6.
findings.number: 0.4 to 28.1 days between deliveries; MOQ ₹570 to ₹1.11 L
findings.soWhat: A new SKU's replenishment cycle is decided by which vendor carries it, and that is now knowable before committing. Put fast-moving new lines (diapers, OTC, frozen) on the ≤3-day vendors (Himachal Wholesale Syndicate at ₹570 min, Leela Associates) and slow lines (optical, hardware) on the monthly Chandigarh/Delhi runs.

findings.claim: Pincode geography of the catchment, confirmed: 173101 is Baru Sahib AND Rajgarh plus ~26 villages (Bhawani, Habban, Nohra, Sarahan-side hamlets) — one pincode for the whole tehsil pocket. Nahan 173001, Paonta Sahib 173025, Kala Amb 173030, Sarahan 173024; Parwanoo 173220, Solan 173212, Saproon/Deothi 173211, Baddi 173205, Kumarhatti 173229. Full postal address: Baru Sahib, Via Rajgarh, Teh. Pachhad, Distt. Sirmaur, HP – 173101.
findings.evidence: https://www.mapsofindia.com/pincode/india/himachal-pradesh/sirmaur/ and .../solan/; address from https://www.akalacademy.in/contact-us (phones 9816033303-05, toll free 18001807755).
findings.number: 1 pincode = 28 named places
findings.soWhat: Any courier or vendor 'serviceable to 173101' check is meaningless at village granularity — deliveries land at Rajgarh or the campus gate and are carried in. Every vendor MOU should name 'Baru Sahib campus, Via Rajgarh' as the delivery point, not the pincode.

findings.claim: ARY's supply spine has four geographic legs, and Himachal is only 43% of it. 12m purchases by supplier GST state: HP (02) ₹2.71 Cr / 31 suppliers; Delhi (07) ₹1.01 Cr / 68 suppliers; Haryana (06) ₹62.0 L / 16; Chandigarh (04) ₹59.8 L / 6; Punjab (03) ₹9.3 L / 9; Maharashtra (27) ₹3.4 L; plus ₹1.28 Cr from GSTIN-less vendors. By pincode the hubs are Parwanoo 173220 ₹1.02 Cr, Naraingarh 134203 ₹71 L, Solan 173212 ₹55.9 L, Sonipat 131101 ₹42 L, Rajgarh/Baru Sahib 173101 ₹27.7 L, Chandni Chowk 110006 ₹25.8 L across 27 vendors.
findings.evidence: ary query grouping 12m PurchaseHeader by LEFT(a.GSTINNo,2) and separately by a.Pincode.
findings.number: HP ₹2.71 Cr (43%), Delhi ₹1.01 Cr, Haryana ₹62 L, Chandigarh ₹59.8 L
findings.soWhat: Parwanoo–Solan is the FMCG artery, Naraingarh the fresh artery, Chandni Chowk the garment artery, Chandigarh the household artery. Slot every new category onto the artery that already runs, and only build a new leg for the pharmacy.

findings.claim: JIVO group companies are already ARY suppliers, so intercompany supply is a proven mechanism — but the Delhi leg is dormant. Jivo Wellness Pvt Ltd - Haryana Branch (06AACCJ4223F1Z0, Sonipat): 67 bills ₹32.2 L, plus a new 'Vend-06' account since Apr-2026 (18 bills ₹8.5 L). Jivo Wellness Pvt Ltd - Delhi (07AACCJ4223F1ZY): 19 bills ₹9.4 L, last 2024-09-03. Jivo Mart Pvt Ltd - Punjab (03AAFCJ4102J1Z0, Patiala): 6 bills ₹8.1 L, last 2024-03-31.
findings.evidence: ary query on PurchaseHeader joined AccountMaster WHERE AccountName LIKE '%Jivo%', all time, grouped with min/max VoucherDate.
findings.number: ₹50.2 L of intercompany supply all-time; Delhi leg dead 23 months
findings.soWhat: If JIVO wants Delhi HO involved, the working pattern is Delhi/Sonipat invoicing ARY as a vendor — not Delhi running a buying desk. Reviving account 284 (Delhi, 07AACCJ4223F1ZY) is the realistic way to put HO-negotiated national deals (Nestle, ITC, P&G) into Baru Sahib at HO prices.

findings.claim: Additional named frozen and general-trade vendors exist in the Solan–Baddi–Parwanoo belt beyond ARY's current list: Nav Durga Traders (Parwanoo), Madhvi Agencies (Solan), Dharam Chand And Bros (Solan), Kedar Trading Company (Baddi), Crystal Mega Mart (Baddi), Shivansh Traders (Baddi), Devyani Food Industries Limited (Baddi), Ashu Food and Anahat Foods (Solan). Baby/hygiene: Navi Hygiene & Healthcare Pvt Ltd (Solan), Easeplus Healthcare Pvt Ltd (Solan), Aurum Medicare Pvt Ltd (Baddi), Sri Rajbhan Enterprises (Solan), M.K. Enterprises (Nalagarh), Sahil Pharma (Solan) — brands seen: Pampers, MamyPoko, Huggies, Libero, Babyhug, Little Angel.
findings.evidence: https://dir.indiamart.com/solan/frozen-food.html and https://dir.indiamart.com/solan/baby-diapers.html (fetched 2026-08-28). Directory listings — company existence sourced, phones and trading status not verified.
findings.number: ~20 additional named vendors in the 60–90 km belt
findings.soWhat: Gives the purchase desk a real second-quote list so the incumbent Parwanoo/Solan vendors face price competition on the new lines — worth more than the vendor names themselves.

findings.claim: ARY's own 12-month P&L shape from the same book: purchases ₹6.36 Cr against gross billed sales ₹8.18 Cr at Baru Sahib, implying ~22% gross margin on sales.
findings.evidence: ary query: SUM(BillAmount) PurchaseHeader IsDeleted=0 from 2025-08-01 = ₹63,579,409; SUM(BillAmount) SaleHeader same window = ₹81,807,636.

confidenceGap: Two different grades of evidence are mixed here and they should not be read as equal. Everything about ARY's own routes is HIGH confidence — the principal-to-distributor map, the delivery cadences, the effective minimum orders, the ₹1.28 Cr of GSTIN-less purchases, the zero medicine and zero optical SKUs, and the finding that Delhi HO has booked exactly one purchase voucher for ₹0 in 3.5 years all came from live SQL against FR8HODBNEW and can be re-run in a minute. Everything about NEW vendors is LOW-to-MEDIUM: the named pharma, frozen, diaper, optical and electrical companies come from IndiaMART directory pages, so the companies exist but their phone numbers, trading status and willingness to deliver 60–100 km up a hill road to 173101 are all unverified — nobody has called one. The session's 200-call WebSearch budget was exhausted after four searches, so the rest of this lane ran on WebFetch against guessed URLs, and eleven of those fetches failed (hpmilkfed.org SSL expired, drugcontrol.hp.gov.in and investhimachal.hp.gov.in DNS-dead, McCain cert error, four IndiaMART 404s, indiacode 403, DuckDuckGo CAPTCHA) — which is why HP Milkfed's Sirmaur presence, the actual HP drug-licence fee schedule, the IMS Act retail restrictions, and every mobile-accessory and hand-tool vendor name remain unresolved. All road distances and lead times for routes that do not yet exist are estimates anchored on the observed cadence of routes that do. And the single largest number in the recommendations — ₹2 L/month from a pharmacy — is an estimate that has not been tested against the one fact that could halve it: whether the campus hospital already gives residents their medicines.
